shortDescription: Create or remove an inline OpenVPN client configuration (.ovpn) from Easy-RSA client credentials

options.name: chdir
options.description: Change into this directory before processing. Useful if Easy-RSA PKI paths are relative to a working directory.

options.name: creates
options.description: If this path exists, the module returns early with no changes. When C(state=present) and C(creates) exists, the message will indicate the configuration is already created.

options.name: destination_directory
options.description: Directory where the generated C(<username>.ovpn) and checksum file are written. The directory must exist.

options.name: force
options.description: If enabled, removes existing destination files before (re)creating the configuration. This also removes the checksum file.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the OVPN configuration should be present or absent.

options.name: username
options.description: Client name/user to build the configuration for. Used to locate Easy-RSA key/certificate and to name the output files.
